maya-peopleops: Heads-up — Rachel submitted a promotion for Priya (IC -> Sr IC). Approval recorded as 2026-08-01 but manager says effective date should be 2026-07-15 to reflect mid-cycle milestone. Payroll cutoff is 2026-07-14. Can we fix without a full re-approval?

rachel-eng-manager: Yep, I accidentally clicked 8/1. We want comp to start 7/15. Small retro only (7/15-7/31). What's the minimal paperwork to get this included in July payroll?

tom-hr: Minimal path: manager email (explicit effective date + new salary) as PDF or signed email, Lattice snapshot, and payroll ticket before cutoff. If retro <= 30 days comp director approval suffices; >30 days would need Legal.

priya-ic: Quick confirm: salary from $120k -> $132k, no change to bonus. Will this affect my vesting schedule?

comp-director: Promo doesn't re-date prior RSUs; we'll issue any promo grant separately if approved. For retro <=30d I'm fine signing off once manager email + Lattice attach.

jess-payroll: Payroll-bot: next run 2026-07-20 18:00 UTC, cutoff 2026-07-14 23:59 UTC. To include a retro in July we need ticket + docs by cutoff. Use subject: "Backpay - Priya 33421 - effective 2026-07-15" and attach manager email + lattice snapshot.

payroll-bot: Payroll run scheduled: 2026-07-20T18:00:00Z. Cutoff: 2026-07-14T23:59:00Z. Manual adjustments after cutoff processed in next run as a separate adj.

tax-us: FYI for US employees: retro pay is taxed in the month it is run. If employee prefers estimate of net retro we can provide a pre-run net estimate in the ticket. If retro causes large withholding we can discuss net smoothing but that's exception-based.

rachel-eng-manager: Thanks — I'll send signed email now and upload Lattice snapshot. Created ticket PAY-2026-6001 and tagged @jess-payroll + @comp-director.

jess-payroll: Received PAY-2026-6001. Status: awaiting comp-director sign-off and payroll calc. We'll post preliminary cents in the ticket by EOD. Example calc used for estimate: (new_salary - old_salary)/365 * prorated_days.

comp-director: Signed off on PAY-2026-6001 at 11:05 UTC. Priya: comp director confirms no bonus change; equity unaffected.

jess-payroll: PAY-2026-6001 updated: approved for July run. Estimated retro posted in ticket; final payout will show in payroll statement.

rachel-eng-manager: Great, thanks everyone. Priya: sorry for the confusion — congrats! :tada:

priya-ic: Appreciate the fast turnaround and the estimate — thank you all.

maya-peopleops: I'll add this flow to the playbook: 1) manager signed email template, 2) Lattice snapshot, 3) payroll ticket with prefix Backpay, 4) comp director sign-off for <=30 days, Legal for >30 days, 5) tag tax when international. Closing thread once ticket is fully reconciled.
